property.name: StudiesJson
property.description-key: The rate study to edit, as JSON. Accepts one study object, an array of studies, or an export envelope. Bind to the Dataverse or SharePoint column holding the study payload.

property.name: Mode
property.description-key: Single: edit one study; the app owns the study list. Workspace: the component shows its own study list and dashboard.

property.name: ReadOnly
property.description-key: Show the study without allowing edits — for reviewers, or while the record is locked by someone else.

property.name: AiResponseId
property.description-key: Echo of AI request ID once the flow has finished. Changing this delivers the reply to the waiting request.

property.name: AiResponseText
property.description-key: The analysis text returned by the Power Automate flow for the matching AI request ID.

property.name: AiResponseError
property.description-key: Set this instead of AI response text when the flow failed; the message is shown to the user.

property.name: StudiesJsonOut
property.description-key: The edited study payload. Patch this back to the host data source in OnChange when Last event is 'save'.

property.name: ChangedStudyId
property.description-key: ID of the study the last change belongs to.

property.name: StudyCount
property.description-key: Number of studies currently loaded in the component.

property.name: LastEvent
property.description-key: What the component last asked the app to do: save, file, or ai-request.

property.name: LastEventAt
property.description-key: ISO timestamp of the last event. Always changes, so OnChange fires even when two identical events occur in a row.

property.name: FileName
property.description-key: Name of the generated file when Last event is 'file'.

property.name: FileMimeType
property.description-key: MIME type of the generated file.

property.name: FileBase64
property.description-key: Base64 contents of the generated file. Save with SharePointIntegration or a Power Automate flow.

property.name: FileSizeBytes
property.description-key: Decoded size of the generated file.

property.name: AiRequestId
property.description-key: Correlation ID for the pending analysis request. Pass it back as AI response ID with the reply.

property.name: AiRequestJson
property.description-key: The analysis request: { id, system, messages, maxTokens }. Send it to your approved model through a Power Automate flow.
